kernel: the 8-row verify GEMM (qmm8*), its X8 table prep (x8_prep, x8_prep2), SwiGLU (swiglu_x8), fused gate/up (qmm8_gu*), and the MoE 8-row tile and small-expert kernels
summary: Kapitsa's trunk verify GEMM family: every projection of a speculative verify pass (R <= 8 token rows; 16/32-row wide tree verifies as tiles of 8) runs as 8x8x8 half simdgroup MMAs over the integer codes of MLX affine 4-bit weights read in place, with the activation permutation precomputed into X8 tables (half inputs in fragment lane order plus fp32 group sums) and one fp32 epilogue per 64-group. verify8_fuse.metal merges adjacent small passes bitwise into single dispatches.

settings.name: rows_per_tile
settings.condition: always

settings.name: wide_verify_max_rows
settings.condition: dense Qwen35 tree verify where verify_wide_ok holds; 16/32 rows run as 2/4 row tiles of 8

settings.name: weight_group_size
settings.condition: always for qmm8 (another group size is fatal)

settings.name: weight_layout
settings.value: MLX affine in place: uint32-packed nibbles low nibble first, bf16 scale and bias per 64-group, no repacked weight image
settings.condition: always
settings.note: common.h:6 states the shared convention (uint32-packed, bf16 scales/biases per group); the lane reads 16 contiguous codes of its weight row as one uint2 (verify8.metal:300)

settings.name: mma_shape
settings.value: 8x8x8 simdgroup half MMA with fp32 accumulate; A and B written through thread_elements() in registers, no simdgroup_load
settings.condition: always

settings.name: code_operand_modes
settings.value: CM 0: (codes & 0x000F000F) | 0x64006400 = exact half 1024 + q; CM 1: bare code bits = half subnormal q * 2^-24
settings.condition: cm knob 0 or 1

settings.name: subnormal_scale
settings.condition: cm = 1 (default): the fp32 epilogue scales the subnormal MMA chain by s * 2^24

settings.name: operand_mode
settings.condition: default (NI_V8_CM unset); 0 = codes as 1024 + q
settings.note: bench_v8: error 2-5e-7 (subnormal) vs 2-3e-5 (1024 + q); teacher-forced 27B verify max |logit diff| vs plain decode 0.025 vs 0.051

settings.name: two_groups_per_step
settings.condition: pair knob 1 (default) and (K / 64) % 2 == 0, so the scale/bias pair of two groups loads in one 4-byte read
settings.note: 27B, 8-row verify, CM 1: -0.7 to -0.9 ms per DFlash2 cycle; a prefetching version took 96 registers and was no faster (verify8.metal:409-411)

settings.name: group_epilogue
settings.value: fp32 per 64-group after each MMA chain: CM 0 y += dot*s + sum(x)*(b - 1024*s); CM 1 y += dot*s*2^24 + sum(x)*b
settings.condition: always

settings.name: input_table
settings.value: X8 table per 64-group: the 8 rows' inputs as halfs in B-fragment lane order, table[(g*32+lane)*16+...], plus precomputed fp32 group sums per row
settings.condition: always; rows t >= R are zero
settings.note: sums written by x8_prep (verify8.metal:145) and x8_prep2 (verify8.metal:234-243), read per group in the GEMM (verify8.metal:287)

settings.name: lane_operand_loads
settings.value: one uint2 (16 codes, 8 bytes) per fragment-group of weights; two 16-byte uint4 table reads per lane-group of activations
settings.condition: always (4-bit)

settings.name: fragments_per_simdgroup
settings.condition: 4-bit dense GEMMs; NI_V8_NF overrides
settings.note: formula: nf_def = bits == 8 ? 1 : 2, and qmm8x2 forces 1

settings.name: threadgroup_threads
settings.value: 32 * cs * ks (8 simdgroups default, 16 only for the qmm8snb16 variants)
settings.condition: always; cs and ks come from v8_plan
settings.note: column blocks of 8 * nf rows per threadgroup step (verify8.metal:592); cap cs = min(cs, (ks > 8 ? 16 : 8) / ks) (qwen35_v8.cpp:468)

settings.name: k_slice_plan
settings.value: kplan 2 (default): K >= 4096: ks 8 with cs 1; K >= 16384: ks 16; below: ks = groups>=16 ? 4 : groups>=8 ? 2 : 1 with cs 8; kplan 3 (default on M1): k-slices of >= 16 groups, at most 16384 simdgroups
settings.condition: v8_plan with NI_V8_PLAN=2 and the kplan knob
settings.note: gpr = K / 64; grid grows until about 64 simdgroups per GPU core (full = 64 * core count) but never below 4 groups per slice (qwen35_v8.cpp:435-437)

settings.name: k_slice_reduction
settings.value: the ks k-slices of each column block are summed in a fixed order through threadgroup memory; the kslice-0 simdgroup holds the total
settings.condition: always when ks > 1

settings.name: x8_prep_grid
settings.value: x8_prep2: K/256 threadgroups x 256 threads when K % 256 == 0 (default); else x8_prep: 8 threadgroups x 256 threads
settings.condition: NI_V8_PREP=2 default; wide tree verifies require x8_prep2
settings.note: selection at qwen35_v8.cpp:398-400; x8_prep2 stages the table through threadgroup memory for coalesced 16-byte stores (verify8.metal:156-160)

settings.name: gate_up_path
settings.value: gate and up as two segments of one qmm8 GEMM (fp32 rows) plus swiglu_x8 when gusplit=1 (default) and I % 256 == 0 and I <= dense_I; else the fused qmm8_gu kernels at 512 threads (default variant qmm8_gu1k2snb_b4 with cm 1 + pair)
settings.condition: gusplit knob and shape
settings.note: the fused qmm8_gu1k2 kernel (8 column slices x 2 k-slices) streamed ~10% slower; default NI_V8_GU=1k2 'measured best on both models' (qwen35_v8.cpp:56)

settings.name: swiglu_grid
settings.condition: split gate/up path

settings.name: moe_small_expert_rows
settings.condition: MoE: experts used by <= 2 rows leave the 8-row MMA tiles (NI_V8_MOE_SMALL, max 2)

settings.name: moe_split_expert_rows
settings.condition: MoE sampled verify: experts used by 3..8 rows run ceil(rows/2) 2-row MMA-exact tiles (NI_V8_MOE_SPLIT)

settings.name: moe_small_tile_rows
settings.condition: moe8e MMA-exact passes (sampled verifies need row-independent expert numerics)
settings.note: 4-row tiles ran slower than two 2-row tiles each: 11.98 vs 10.81 ms per verify (35B, 64 tokens teacher-forced, sampled-verify numerics)

settings.name: fused_passes_mask
settings.condition: default fuse knob: bit 1 = moe8_combine_x8 (MoE combine + the next norm's X8 table), bit 4 = gdn_prep_verify8 (rows' q/k norms reduced together); both bitwise the passes they replace

settings.name: verify_rows_min
settings.condition: default knobs; verify dispatches take the 8-row MMA GEMMs from this row count up
settings.note: formula: NI_V8=1 gives 2, else MoE or NI_V8=0 gives 5, else 3; MoE keeps small-batch kernels below 5 rows because its verify unions the rows' experts

notes: Doc checks: every mechanism our KAPITSA_KERNELS.md Item 7 claims is in the source. Two wording gaps. (1) Our doc's epilogue 's * dot + b * sum(x)' is the subnormal CM 1 form, which is the shipped default; the 1024 + q form (CM 0) also carries a -1024*s cancellation term, y += dot*s + sum(x)*(b - 1024*s) (verify8.metal:11). The '8 rows' group sums precomputed' claim holds: the preps write sums of the half-rounded inputs per group and row. (2) 'No threadgroup dequant and no simdgroup_load' holds for every shipped GEMM variant, but the file also contains threadgroup-staged table variants (v8_run_tg, V 6/7) that are explicitly 'experiments measured and dropped' and not instantiated (verify8.metal:691-694), and the MoE small-expert passes (moe8s2, moe8e) stage operands in threadgroup memory by design. Our doc's 'their own timings are not in the repo (tools/bench_qmm8.cpp prints them, none are recorded)' is true of the bench tools, but the repo does record kernel timings in docs/kflash.md and in host-source comments, cited under measured. Scope caveat: on M5 (Apple10) with macOS 26 the dense 4-bit verify GEMMs leave these MMA kernels for the qmm8t tensor-op kernels (gate qwen35_v8.cpp:547, knob tw default 1), so this pinned set is the pre-M5 path; qmm8t lives in src/kernels/tensor/verify8t.metal and is not covered here. Exactness caveats the repo itself records: the MMA chain sums in another order than a scalar dot and the activations are half (11-bit mantissa), so it is not bit-equal to our GEMV; 0x6400 gives exactly 1024 + q because half has 11 bits of mantissa and q <= 15, and the bare-code form is exact because half subnormals step by 2^-24; the moe8e passes rely on a per-step fp32 rounding property of simdgroup_multiply_accumulate that mma_chain_check re-checks on each GPU before use (verify8.metal:1502-1533). verify8_fuse.metal is bitwise pass fusion, not a different GEMM: moe8_combine_x8 (grid 8 x D/4, D <= 2048) and gdn_prep_verify8 (grid C/128 x 128, plus a wide-tree variant for 16/32 rows). The moe8e passes hardcode the 35B expert shape (gate/up K 2048, down K 512). Timing numbers in source comments rarely name a machine or run count; treat them as indicative and re-run their bench tools (tools/bench_v8, tools/bench_qmm8, tools/bench_verify8) for anything load-bearing.
